# Hjelt Foundations

> Three independent foundations supporting research in spina bifida, type 2 diabetes, and contemporary art through grants, fellowships, and cultural programming.

Hjelt Foundations operates three distinct initiatives: the Diabetes Foundation funding precision medicine research at institutions like Lund University, the Spina Bifida Foundation supporting neural tube defect research, and the Art Foundation promoting contemporary art through lectures, exhibitions, and partnerships. The foundations are based in Finland with international research reach.

## Key Topics

- Type 2 Diabetes
- Spina Bifida
- Diabetes Research
- Beta-cell Function
- Insulin Secretion
- Insulin Resistance
- Precision Medicine

## Diabetes Research

- [Diabetes Foundation Research Overview](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/diabetes-foundation/research): Overview of Diabetes Foundation research areas and initiatives
- [Precision Medicine in Type 2 Diabetes](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/precision-medicine-in-type-2-diabetes): Grant holder report by Rashmi Prasad on precision medicine in Type 2 diabetes
- [Transcriptional Regulation of Human Islet Development and Function](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/transcriptional-regulation-of-human-islet-development-and-function): Grant holder research summary by Isabella Artner on islet development
- [A Step Towards Customised Treatment for Type 2 Diabetes](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/a-step-towards-customised-treatment-for-type-2-diabetes): Grant holder research by Petter Storm on personalized diabetes treatment
- [Blocking Aberrant Cell Surface Mitochondrial VDAC1 and Insulin Secretion](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/blocking-aberrant-cell-surface-mitochondrial-vdac1-is-associated-with-restoration-of-insulin-secretion-in-diabetes): Grant holder research by Albert Salehi on insulin secretion restoration
- [Effect of Salivary Amylase Copy Number on Postprandial Response](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/effect-of-having-low-or-high-salivary-amylase-copy-number-on-postprandial-response-to-different-starch-doses): Grant holder research by Emily Sonestedt on carbohydrate metabolism genetics
- [Life Without Insulin: Testing Anti-Diabetic Role of Inflammation Candidates](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/life-without-insulin-testing-the-anti-diabetic-role-of-a-candidate-involved-in-inflammation): Grant holder research by Sanda Ljubicic on diabetes prevention mechanisms
- [Stimulate Adhesion Signaling to Enhance Insulin Secretion and Beta-Cell Survival](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/stimulate-adhesion-signaling-to-enhance-insulin-secretion-and-cell-survival): Grant holder research by Caroline Arous on beta-cell function enhancement
- [Possible Mechanisms Behind Insulin Resistance](https://www.hjeltfoundations.org/possible-mechanisms-behind-insulin-resistance-to-be-mapped): Grant holder research by Olga Göransson on insulin resistance mechanisms
